notablePrerequisites:
Either Phyrexian Metamorph or Thornbite Staff attached to Reckoner Bankbuster, with the other attached to Coretapper.
Reckoner Bankbuster and Coretapper do not have summoning sickness.
Reckoner Bankbuster has exactly one charge counter on it.
description:
Activate Reckoner Bankbuster by paying {2}, tapping it, and removing a charge counter from it, causing you to draw a card, create a Treasure artifact token and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Reckoner Bankbuster.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pilot token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pilot dies, Coretapper and Reckoner Bankbuster triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

uses.name: Phyrexian Metamorph
uses.cardState: as a copy of Thornbite Staff
